articleTitle: Coarse wavelength division multiplexer on silicon-on-insulator for 100 GbE
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A four-channel cascaded MZI based de-multiplexer at O-band with coarse channel spacing of 20 nm and band flatness of 13 nm is demonstrated on silicon-on-insulator. The device shows a mean crosstalk and insertion loss below -16 dB and 2.5 dB.

articleTitle: Isolator free optical I/O core transmitter by using quantum dot laser
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We developed isolator-free optical transmitters for optical I/O core by using quantum-dot lasers. The signal degradation by optical feedback reflected within the transmitter was negligible and the estimated BER was less than 1e-12 at 25-Gbps.

articleTitle: Enabling large-scale deployment of photonics through cost-efficient and scalable packaging
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Enabling single-mode photonic packaging in high-throughput microelectronic equipment can dramatically improve cost and scalability. We experimentally demonstrate such solution using 12-fiber interfaces and flipped-chip lasers. We measure -1.3dB peak fiber-to-chip transmission.

articleTitle: 60 Gb/s PAM-4 operation with a silicon microring modulator
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report high-speed pulse-amplitude modulation (PAM) with silicon microring modulators. We demonstrate PAM-4 signals up to 30 GBaud.

articleTitle: Reliability study of digital silicon photonic MEMS switches
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the reliability test of 50×50 digital silicon photonic MEMS switches. The switch operates reliably over 10 billion cycles and up to 48 hours of continuous contact in ambient environment without packaging.

articleTitle: High-bandwidth, waveguide-coupled Ge p-i-n photodiode with high C- and L-band responsivity
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a germanium photodiode showing, at -2V bias, responsivity exceeding 0.8A/W across the entire C- and L-band, together with 40GHz zero bias bandwidth, which strongly extends the application range of silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Fully integrated SOI wavelength meter based on phase shift technique
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present an MZI (Mach-Zehnder Interferometer) silicon-on-insulator (SOI) wavelength meter. The device integrates photo detectors and modulators. The phase shift between carrier and modulated signal is linearly correlated to the input wavelength.

articleTitle: Scaling up silicon photonic switch fabrics
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The development of commercially viable silicon photonic switch fabrics will require industry to develop low-crosstalk scalable architecture while using, the highest performance optical components available. We examine the challenges associated with this development.

articleTitle: Phase-change materials for Group-IV electro-optical switching and modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: This paper reviews the invention, design and theoretical simulation of 2 x 2 and 1 x 4 optical routing switches. Insertion loss and crosstalk performance in the 1.55 to 3.0 μm wavelength range are predicted. The electrically actuated optical layer is a thin film of Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Te<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> or GeTe or GeSe whose thickness is in the 10 to 100-nm range. This film was embedded at the centerline of an SOI, SON, or GeOI channel waveguide structure for MZI and directional-coupler switching Alternatively, to switch free-space light beams, Ge prisms sandwiching the film were employed. Devices are self-sustaining in each of their two states. Experiments are needed to confirm assumptions made in the theory about voltage requirements, speed, PCM index, and manufacturing techniques.

articleTitle: Advanced silicon photonic transceivers
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the development of Luxtera's silicon photonics platform for the production of high-speed optical transceivers using a hybrid-integrated approach.

articleTitle: Comparison of photonic 2×2 3-dB couplers for 220 nm silicon-on-insulator platforms
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present an experimental performance comparison of various types of 3-dB coupler fabricated on SOI platforms. Each type has its own advantages and disadvantages, suggesting that the choice of coupler is driven by the application.

articleTitle: High speed and highly efficient Si optical modulator with strained SiGe layer
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We developed a high speed and high efficiency of depletion type Si optical modulator (Si-MOD) with a pn junction by applying a p-type-doped strained SiGe layer which was slacked on the lateral pn junction type Si-MOD. We designed the optimum Si-MOD structure and demonstrated a very high modulation efficiency of 0.81 Vcm. which is one of die mosl efficient in Si-MODs with a pn junction. We also demonstrated u high speed operation of 25 Gbps for the Si-MOD al around 1.3 μm wavelength.

articleTitle: Fabrication of high bit rate, monolith ically integrated receivers in photonic BiCMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present results of photonic BiCMOS process development enabling the fabrication of monolithically integrated receivers for 40Gbps and beyond. Focus is on the challenge to fabricate simultaneously 200GHz SiGe HBTs and Ge photodiodes with enough bandwidth.

articleTitle: Source-synchronous optical link using mode-division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A method to send clock and data information over an optical link using mode multiplexing is presented. Use of this method will allow for source-synchronous (clock-forwarded) data communication between interconnected elements.

articleTitle: Simple method for integrating DFB laser and silicon photonics platform
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A simple and practical method for integrating a DFB laser and a silicon photonics platform without additional optical components such as lenses and an isolator is proposed. Optical-coupling and feedback-tolerance characteristics are experimentally measured.

articleTitle: A waveguide coupled LED on SOI by heterogeneous integration of InP-based membranes
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A novel design geometry for an optically pumped LED by integrating thin III-V membranes on SOI is proposed. Simulation results predict power efficiency and fabrication tolerance. We present a first proof-of-concept demonstration of the LED.

articleTitle: A wavelength-selective polarization rotating reflector using a partially-etched asymmetric Bragg grating on an SOI strip waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on a wave length-selective polarization rotating reflector using a partially-etched asymmetric Bragg grating on a silicon-on-insulator strip waveguide that has a maximum polarization-extinction-ratio greater than 27 dB and a 1-dl! bandwidth of 2.6 nm.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic devices for complex modulation formats and coherent communications
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Silicon photonics has the potential to achieve compact and power-efficient coherent optical transceivers. This is especially needed for next generation pluggable modules to be used in metro and short-distance coherent optical systems. We review recently reported silicon photonic devices for this application.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic subwavelength grating based integrated optical delay lines
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel integrated optical delay line approach based on silicon subwavelength gratings (SWGs). By 30% change in duty-cycle of SWG waveguides with a same length of 8mm to control their group index, up to ~30ps time-delay was achieved.

articleTitle: Low-loss silicon rectangular waveguides fabricated by anisotoropic wet etching for roughness reduction
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Simple fabrication of low-loss Si/SiO2 waveguides with a flat side wall is proposed. Waveguides oriented to the <;11-2> direction on the Si (110) plane are fabricated by anisotropic wet etching and the lowest propagation loss is 1.4 dB/cm.

articleTitle: Intraband crosstalk of SOI microring resonator-based optical add-drop multiplexers
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We compare intraband crosstalk of first-order, cascaded, and series-coupled microring optical add-drop multiplexers. We show that first-order microring devices are unsuitable for simultaneous add-drop operation and we present filter requirements for cascaded and series-coupled devices.

articleTitle: Low-voltage and low-loss silicon modulator based on carrier accumulation using a vertical slot waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We optimized a silicon ring resonator modulator embedding a low-voltage and low-loss vertical Capacitive phase shifter. It exhibits an extinction ratio of 10 dB at 2 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf>, with only 1.8 dB insertion losses.

articleTitle: Validation by 25km error free transmission of 10Gb/s directly modulated III-V/SOI hybrid DFB laser
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Hyhrid III-V/SOI DFB lasers was designed and fabricated using wafer bonding; a low chirp parameter (α<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">H</sub>) of 2.4 was measured and 10Gb/s direct modulation demonstrated in an error-free transmission in a 25km single mode fiber.

articleTitle: A low-power biasing scheme for silicon-on-insulator traveling-wave modulators
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose a biasing scheme for silicon-on-insulator traveling-wave Mach-Zehnder modulators which eliminates the termination-related DC power consumption due to biasing and we present measurements on a high-speed modulator that uses this scheme.

articleTitle: Excess carrier lifetime in epitaxially grown layers of germanium on silicon
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We investigate the layer thickness dependence of the excess carrier lifetime of germanium on silicon by means of time-resolved photoluminescence. We find that a bulk lifetime > 90 ns is achievable for the undoped germanium.

articleTitle: Development of silicon nitride arrayed waveguide grating by physical vapor deposition at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We designed and fabricated SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-based AWG using physical vapor deposition technique at room temperature, compatible with low thermal budget over a wide application range. Preliminary results indicate filtering performances capable of dense WDM on a chip.

articleTitle: 1.3-μm Quantum-dot lasers integrated with spot-size converter for improved coupling efficiency to waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: 1.3-μm quantum-dot lasers integrated with a thickness tapered waveguide as a spot-size converter have been developed to improve coupling efficiency to silicon photonics devices. Improvements of far-field patterns and coupling efficiency were experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-speed 8×8 electro-optic switch matrix based on silicon PIN structure waveguides
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A high-speed non-blocking silicon 8×8 switch matrix was demonstrated based on Benes network and carrier-dispersion electro-optic controlling. The extinction ratios are 18.3~25.5dB on “all-Cross” and 13.3~19.0dB on “all-Bar” status at 1550nm.

articleTitle: A silicon photonics network-on-chip architecture based on mode and wavelength switching
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: This work presents an integrated mode- and wavelength-switched network-on-chip architecture, enabling high-throughput and flexible core-to-core communication. An implementation of the tunable mode selector is proposed, based on supermodes in an array of coupled single-mode waveguides.

articleTitle: Compact silicon rib-waveguide electro-absorption modulator using multiple indium-tin-oxide layers
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose a novel practical design of silicon rib-waveguide electro-absorption modulator using two indium-tin-oxide layers with optimized carrier densities. Efficient and low-loss modulation is numerically demonstrated for a 1-μm-long modulator.

articleTitle: Enhanced coupling with metal-assisted gratings for photonic circuits on 0.18-um bulk CMOS platform
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The input/output coupling efficiency of a grating coupler is enhanced by utilizing the existing metal layers in standard bulk CMOS platform as mirrors. Experimental results demonstrate 5.5-dB improvement on fiber-to-fiber coupling that matches simulated results.

articleTitle: Low-voltage Si-Ge avalanche photodiode
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Here we report a Si-Ge avalanche photodiode (APD) with a breakdown voltage of only -9.8V. The highest measured bandwidth is 12GHz at gain of 15 giving a 180GHz gain-bandwidth product at 1550nm wavelength.

articleTitle: External-cavity hybrid laser with silicon photonic crystal cavity-based resonant reflector
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report an external-cavity laser comprising a III-V reflective-SOA and a Si Photonic Crystal (PhC) cavity-based resonant reflector. Experimental output powers of mW-level and >25 dB SMSR were observed.

articleTitle: Subwavelength grating filters in SOI
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We denwnstrate subwavelength grating filters in silicon-on-insulator based on Bragg gratings and racetrack resonators. The Bragg grating has a 3 dB bandwidth = 0.5 nm and reflectivity > 90%. the resonator has a 3 dB bandwidth = 1 nm and extinction ratio > 33 dB.

articleTitle: Wide FSR silicon-on-insulator microring resonator with bent couplers
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: This work demonstrates a silicon-on-insulator microring resonator with a 2.75 μm radius, fabricated using 248 nm optical lithography, that employs bent couplers and achieves a 33.4 nm FSR and a 3-dB bandwidth of 25 GHz.

articleTitle: A simulation tool development roadmap to support a scalable silicon photonics design ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a vision for photonic circuit simulation within sophisticated EDA-style design flows and the tool development roadmap to achieve it. Our approach aims to deliver highly-usable, predictive capabilities for a variety of use cases, that seamlessly interoperates with 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-party, best-in-class design tools.

articleTitle: Development of silicon photonics products for telecom and datacom
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We review the work performed in Silicon Photonics at TeraXion for telecom and datacom applications. Coherent receivers and intensity modulators along with system tests arc presented. A novel approach for low-loss coupling is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Single SiGe quantum dots deterministically aligned to the antinodes of a photonic crystal cavity mode
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We fabricated photonic crystal nanocavities containing single SiGe QDs deterministically aligned to the antinodes of a cavity mode. Cavity coupling drastically enhances the vertical QD emission and allows, for the first time, the optical characterization of a single SiGe QD. For low excitation intensities, a single exponential PL decay with a time constant of 22ns at T=10K is observed for such a coupled QD-PhC-cavity system.

articleTitle: Ultra-fme Si photonics fabrication technology based on 40-nm-node CMOS process
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The dimension control technology for silicon photonics devices based on 40-nm-node CMOS technology are reviewed. By using ArF immersion lithography in the fabrication technology, the high-level reproducihility in resonant wavelength of demultiplexers (σλ. <1 nm) was achieved, as well as extremely low propagation loss <0.5 dB/cm in silicon wire waveguide for TE single mode propagation in C-band.

articleTitle: Ring resonator memristor with electric input and optical readout functionality
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A memristor based on the nonlinear effect in (lie ultra-high Q Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ring resonator has been firstly proposed and experimentally demonstrated, which is potential to become an important building block in future optoelectronic system.

articleTitle: On-chip hybrid integration of silicon nitride microdisk with colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the fabrication of on-chip freestanding silicon nitride microdisks hybridly integrated with embedded colloidal quantum dots. An efficient coupling of quantum dot emission to resonant disk modes in the visible range is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Compact high-speed electro-optic modulator based on a silicon photonic-crystal nanobeam cavity with gated graphene
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose and numerically study a compact high-speed elcctro-oplic modulator by gating graphene on a silicon photonic-crystal nanobeam cavity. 13.5-dB modulation depth. 133GHz operation speed, and 270-nm FSR are achieved in simulalions.

articleTitle: Optimization approaches to achieve high-Q silicon slot waveguide ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present two approaches to achieve high Q-factors slotted SOI micro-ring resonators: thermal dry oxidation process and coupler refinement methods. Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">loaded</sub> of 122,000 and intrinsic losses below 2.2 dB/cm have been obtained for slot waveguide ring resonators with a 50μm bending radius.

articleTitle: Carrier lifetime assessment in integrated Ge waveguide devices
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Carrier lifetimes in Ge waveguides on Si are deduced from time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy. For a 1 μm wide Ge waveguide, a lifetime of 1.6 ns is estimated for a carrier density of around 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>.

articleTitle: Non-linear model of electronic band structure to highly tensile-strained Germanium
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose a non-linear model based on tight-binding method to obtain, as a function of deformation, the evolution of conduction and valence band around Γ-bandgap of germanium.

articleTitle: Negligible power consumption add/drop switching properties of graphene on SOI microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We investigate the switching reconfiguration properties of graphene on SOI add/drop microring resonators. Graphene can effectively enable/disable the add/drop functionality with negligible power consumption with respect to the typical approach based on thermal tuning.

articleTitle: Investigation of carrier-density dependent transmission properties with Germanium waveguides
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Optical propagation characteristics of unintentionally doped and n-type doped Ge waveguides were investigated to achieve tasing operation (if the Ge laser. An n-type doped Ge waveguide showed significant reduction of its propagation loss under optical pumping.

articleTitle: A compact spiral Mach-Zehnder Interferometer Modulator on SOI process
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A compact, spiral Mach-Zehnder Interferometer modulator with 9GHz 3d B-band width has been demonstrated. The spiral MZ1 structure allows for high density integration and reduces the cost by wrapping two 3mm long phase shifters in a 550μm×650μm silicon area.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable non-blocking 4-port optical router based on microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A reconfigurable non-blocking 4-port optical router based on 4 thermally tuned microring resonators is demonstrated. Wavelength division multiplexing data transmission with the data rate of 8×25 Gbps through its all 12 optical links has been implemented.

articleTitle: Broadband Add/Drop Mode Division Multiplexer based on a Mach-Zehnder interferometer
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A novel kind of Add/Drop Mode Division Multiplexer based on a Mach-Zehnder interferometer with SubWave-length Grating waveguides as arms is presented. The proposed device exhibits less than 1dB insertion loss and more than 20dB extinction ratio in the whole C-Band.

articleTitle: Integration of Group IV photonic components and other integrated optics and impacts on 5G optical networking
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present an overview on integration of Group IV. planar lightwave photonics and impacts on next generation 5G networking, especially distributed clout! data centers under throughput capacity of several Peta-bits/s.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics for on-chip spectrophotometry
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Silicon and Silicon Nitride photonics arc on their way to open the route towards integrated on-chip spectropholometers, Cost, miniaturization, miniaturization, hut also performance advantages ace at the origin of their potential We will discuss several integrated on-chip spectropholometers that are on the eve of commercial lake up.

articleTitle: 1.7 kHz RF linewidth III-V-on-silicon mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: For the first time we demonstrate an anti-colliding mode-locked laser implemented on a III-V-on-silicon platform. In passive mode-locked operation a 1.7kHz 3dB linewidth of the fundamental RF tone at 4.83GHz is obtained.

articleTitle: Surface transfer doping in silicon waveguides: A cause of optical loss
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We show that undoped silicon waveguides may suffer of up to 1.8dB/cm free-carrier absorption caused by improper surface passivation, this result opens new perspectives for low-loss silicon photonics and high-speed gateless devices.

articleTitle: Pd Schottky barrier photodetector integrated with LOCOS-defined SOI waveguides
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Palladium on n-type silicon Schottky barrier photodetectors have been integrated with SOI optical waveguides. The diodes gave optical responsivity of 330 nA/mW at 1310 nm. Dark current density is less than 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> Acm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> at 1 volt reverse bias.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator spatial heterodyne spectrometer chip for the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate fur the first linio a silicon-on-insulator spatial hoterodyne waveguide spectrometer chip operating in i ho mid-infrared. The device comprises a MMI splitting tree, followed by an array of 42 Mach-Zehnder interferometers with linearly increasing optical path differences. The fabricated device was characterized in the 3717-3772 nm wavelength range by retrieving the spectral line of a quantum cascade laser line, with a wavelength resolution of 2.8 nm.

articleTitle: Hydrogenated amorphous silicon photonic devices on synthetic quartz glass substrate
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We have fabricated hydrogenated amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) photonic devices on a synthetic quartz glass substrate. a-Si:H-wire waveguides, ring resonators, and directional couplers were successfully fabricated using a i-line stepper lithograpy.

articleTitle: A high extinction ratio broadband 1310nm MZI switch
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A broadband thermo-optically tuned Mach-Zehnder based SOI switch is designed to operate in O-band with integrated resistive heaters and wavelength insensitive 3-dB couplers. The switch enables >30 dB extinction ratio over 100 nm wavelength range with 9.8 mW/FSR thermal tuning efficiency.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of high-directionality fiber-chip grating coupler with interleaved trenches
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of a new fiber-chip grating coupler concept that exploits the blazing effect by interleaving deep and shallow etch trenches to maximize directionality. The grating couplers were fabricated using both 193 nm deep-ultraviolet lithography and electron beam lithography. The measured peak fiber-chip coupling efficiency is -1.8 dB at a wavelength of 1550 nm, with a 3 dB bandwidth of 52 nm.

articleTitle: Ultra-fme Si photonics fabrication technology based on 40-nm-node CMOS process
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The dimension control technology for silicon photonics devices based on 40-nm-node CMOS technology are reviewed. By using ArF immersion lithography in the fabrication technology, the high-level reproducihility in resonant wavelength of demultiplexers (σλ. <1 nm) was achieved, as well as extremely low propagation loss <0.5 dB/cm in silicon wire waveguide for TE single mode propagation in C-band.

articleTitle: High density integration of Germanium photodiodes on CMOS wafer
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Fabrication of high density vertical Germanium photodiodes (PDs) on top of 200 mm CMOS wafers coming from an external foundry is discussed. Optical performances of stand-alone PDs are compared lo those of CMOS-coupled PDs.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence from suspended Ge/SiGe quantum-well microdisks
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, the photoluminescence from suspended Ge/SiGe quantum-well microdisks. The optical mode resonances of the photoluminescence spectra are associated with Fabry-Perot modes and whispering gallery modes.

articleTitle: Si photonics wavelength-adjustable crosstalk suppression filter by using coarse laser trimming
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We devised a crosstalk suppression filter in Si photonics, whose passband wavelength is adjustable by coarse laser trimming. Results of a proof-of-concept experiment show a crosstalk reduction of 10dB.

articleTitle: Highly strained Ge on Si microdisks with silicon nitride stressors
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Resonant emission is observed up to ~2.3μm from Ge on Si microdisks, strained by silicon nitride stressors. These results demonstrate that compact, highly strained Ge cavities are achievable on Si substrates using CMOS compatible processes.

articleTitle: Impact of GeOx passivation on Dark Current for wafer-bonded Ge-on-insulator metal-semiconductor-metal photodetector
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Effect of GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> passivation on Ge-on-insulator MSM photod erectors (PDs) formed by wafer bonding is investigated. We found GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> passivation of both top and bottom Ge interfaces is important for dark current suppression in MSM PDs.

articleTitle: Evanescent field phase shifting in a silicon nitride waveguide using a coupled silicon slab
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: An approach for electrical modulation of low-loss silicon nitride waveguides is proposed, using a silicon nitride waveguide evanescently loaded with a thin silicon slab. The thermooptic phase-shift characteristics are investigated in a racetrack resonator configuration.

articleTitle: The GeSn laser — Enabler for monolithic integration of photonics on Si
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Reactive Gas Source Epitaxy has been employed to deposit SiGeSn/GeSn alloys on virtual Ge/Si (100) substrates. Optically pumped Fabry-Perol and a-disc lasers have been fabricated emitting from 2.0-2.6 μm in dependence of the Sn concentration.

articleTitle: Strained Ge nanowire with high-Q optical cavity for Ge laser applications
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a novel structure that simultaneously achieves high tensile strain, pseudo-heterostructure, and high-Q optical cavity in a pure Ge layer. Employing our structure in a GeSn layer will enable a truly practical Si-compatible laser.

articleTitle: Optical spectroscopy on strained Ge microbridges at the transition to a direct band gap
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present photoluminescence spectroscopy and failure statistics of Ge suspended bridges fabricated from 200 mm wafers of photonic-grade Germanium-On-Insulator with uniaxial tensile strain up to 4.6% at the crossover to a fundamental direct band gap.

articleTitle: A WDM silicon photonic transmitter based on Mach-Zehnder modulator with surface-normal optical interface
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a 4 × 12.5 Gb/s WDM silicon photonic transmitter based on Mach-Zehnder modulators with surface-normal optical interface which ensure high misalignment-tolerance. Low voltage operation is achieved using 2.5 V differential driving signal.

articleTitle: Band structure and characterization of dilute Ge:C alloys
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Experimental growth of Ge:C with 0.2% C shows a splitting in the direct conduction band valley of 50 meV. Ab initio simulations of the band structure show a gamma valley decrease of 170 meV/%C.

articleTitle: Photocurrent spectroscopy and X-ray microdiffraction study of highly strained germanium nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Germanium has been highly investigated as a potential light emitting material for the monolithic integration of photonic devices on silicon-based electronics. Indeed, despite the indirect nature of its bandgap, sufficient tensile strain could yield efficient light emission. We present here an experimental study of the influence of tensile strain on the direct bandgap of germanium nanostructures, using both bottom-up and top-down approaches [1].

articleTitle: Reconfigurable non-blocking 4-port silicon thermo-optic optical router based on Mach-Zehnder optical switches
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a reconfigurable non-blocking 4-port silicon thermo-optic optical router based on Mach-Zehnder optical switches. Each optical link of the router can manipulate 50 wavelength-division-multiplexing channels with the data-rate of 32 Gbps for each channel.

articleTitle: Heavily phosphorous-doped Germanium thin films for mid-infrared plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Heavily doped Ge thin films grown on different substrates have been investigated by infrared (IR) reflectometry. Screened plasma frequency and losses have been determined to assess the possibilities and limitations of Ge for mid infrared plasmonic.

articleTitle: Distributed Bragg reflectors integration in highly strained Ge micro-bridges on 200 mm GeOI substrates for laser applications
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Highly strained germanium is thought of as a gain medium for silicon photonics laser sources. In order, to turn the bandgap from indirect to direct, tensile strain is nowadays investigated. This could lead in the future to the monolithic integration of efficient germanium-based laser sources with Si microelectronics technologies. Recent results show that several percent of strain can be induced in Ge micro-bridges [1-2]. The other key parameter to build a laser is definition of a cavity. Whispering gallery mode [3] or short cavities like VCSEL or photonic crystals [4-5] were proposed in the literature. Here, we present long and strained cavities that were obtained through the use of Distributed Bragg Reflectors (DBR) on each side of suspended Ge micro-bridges. Devices are fabricated from high quality 200 mm Germanium-On-lnsulator (GeOI) substrates obtained by the Smart-Cut™ technology. Such substrates are used to enhance the rapture strain limit of the germanium bridges thanks to the lack of dislocations at interfaces. Laser design modelling, membrane processing and experimental results will be presented in detail.

articleTitle: Bandwidth and wavelength tunable optical filter based on silicon multiple microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon multiple microring based optical (liter with tunable bandwidth and wavelength. The bandwidth can be tuned from 0.6 to 2.8 nm and the wavelength can be tuned over several nanometers.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared intersubband absorption in p-Ge/SiGe quantum wells grown on Si
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Intersubband absorption from p-Ge quantum wells grown on Si is demonstrated. The absorption can be tuned by adjusting the quantum well thickness. FTIR transmission measurements on as-grown wafers show broad absorption at mid-infrared wavelengths.

articleTitle: Highly efficient BaTiO3 on silicon electro-optic Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A highly efficient electro-nntic modulator based on a hybrid BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/silicon waveguide structure is repotted. A Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L as low as 11.27 V cm in has been achieved by rotating the waveguide structure at an optimum angle.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics based on Ge/SiGe quantum well structures
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Ge/SiGe Quantum well structures have a strong potential to revolutionize silicon photonics. This paper review recent works including high speed modulator and photodetector, electro-refraction, QYV engineering to tune the wavelength and waveguide integration.

articleTitle: Germanium gate phototransistor fabricated on SOI platform
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of a novel near infrared phototransistor provided with a Germanium optical gate and fabricated by means of a commercially available silicon photonics foundry.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength cladding mid-infrared devices
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Suspended structures enable low loss propagation in silicon waveguides for mid-infrared wavelengths by removing the lossy buried oxide (BOX) layer. We previously demonstrated suspended waveguides with a silicon core and a sub-wavelength grating (SWG) lateral cladding, which allows access to the buried oxide layer for under-etching with hydrofluoric acid. Here we show that bends, multimode interference couplers (MMI) and Mach-Zehnder interferometers (MZI) can be successfully implemented in this platform. Specifically, we report waveguides with propagation losses of 1.2 dB/cm, 90° bends with 0.03 dB/bend loss, compact MMI couplers with imbalances of 0.5 dB, and MZI structures with extinction ratios in excess of 24 dB.

articleTitle: Design of feasible silicon interlayer polarization beam splitter toward 3D optical integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: A feasible interlayer polarization-beam-splitter nas designed. By introducing vertical asymmetry directional coupler with different height of Si wire waveguides, a bandwidth of 60 nm with polarization crosstalk of lower than −20 dB was obtained.

articleTitle: On-silicon integration of compact and energy-efficient DFB laser with 40-Gbit/s direct modulation
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Heterogeneous integration of a DFB laser on SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Si substrate is demonstrated by combining direct bonding and epitaxial regrowth techniques. Energy-efficient direct modulation is achieved by reducing cavity length and increasing optical confinement.

articleTitle: Hybrid silicon photonics and electronics solutions for communications, sensing, and imaging
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Silicon photonics offer large bandwidths and low-loss delay, while integrated electronics can provide gain and complex signal processing with much lower overhead. Here, we will discuss a few examples of such hybrid solutions to demonstrate the potential of a more holistic approach to silicon integrated systems.

articleTitle: Integrated bandpass transmission filters based on Sagnac loops incorporating Bragg gratings in SOI
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate integrated bandpass transmission filters based on incorporating uniform and chirped Bragg gratings in Sagnac loops in SOI. We use the latter as an optical spectral shaper to generate chirped microwave waveforms.

articleTitle: Optical coupling between SiOxNy waveguide and Ge mesa structures for bulk-Si photonics platform
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We successfully confirmed controllable optical coupling between a germanium mesa on a bulk-silicon wafer and a low-loss silicon oxynitride waveguide. This coupling structure can be adopted for constructing various active devices on a CMOS-process-friendly bulk-silicon photonics platform.

articleTitle: Design, process and characterization of an arrayed waveguide grating in the 2180–2280cm−1 range
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In this paper, we present the design, process and characterization of an AWC bused on a SiGe graded index waveguide plateform, operating at 4.5μm (2180–2280cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>). A transmission of −5dB and a crosstalk below −20dB arc demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical trapping of Au nanoparticles using SOI photonic crystal slot cavity at sub-mW laser power
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Size and shape sensitive trapping of Au nanoparticles in silicon-on-insulator photonic crystal slot microcavjties at sub-mW power is demonstrated. Coupling to the microcavity via slot waveguides is shown to significantly enhance the transmission signal of the devices.

articleTitle: Graded Ge1−xSnx photodetectors fabricated on Si substrates by rapid melt growth method
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Near-infrared absorption at 2000-nm wavelength is observed in a Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) photodetector on a Si substrate. The device is fabricated by rapid melt growth method with graded Sn concentration up to 5-10%.

articleTitle: Metamaterial waveguide analysis and test-structures for Si photonics
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The design of adiabatic structures that interface metamaterial waveguides to conventional waveguides is outlined and a methodology for the experimental verification of the results of simulations of homogenised structures elaborated.

articleTitle: Second-order silicon photonic differential-equation solver for general linear time-invariant systems
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an on-chip silicon photonic differential-equation solver that can be used to solve second-order constant-coefficient ordinary-differential-equations (ODEs). The feasibility of the device is verified by 5 and 10 Gb/s optical signals.

articleTitle: Microring resonator refractive index sensor with integrated spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present a SOI ring based sensor read-out system. The novelty of the architecture lies in the capability to sense the shifts of multiple peaks simultaneously with an integrated AWG spectrometer.

articleTitle: On chip test structure for fabrication error estimation based on a sequence of coupled resonators
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We report on the realization of an on chip test structure which quantifies the degree of fabrication error of a photolithographic process. The device is based on a sequence of coupled resonators and allows performing a direct on chip test measurement.

articleTitle: Strictly non-blocking 4×4 silicon electro-optic switch matrix
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The first strictly non-blocking 4×4 silicon electro-optic switch matrix has been fabricated. Using single-arm modulation, the crosstalk measured in this test is −13∼27 dB.

articleTitle: Design rules to control the tensile strain in Ge μ-membranes fabricated from GeOI substrates for photonics applications
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Applying the right tensile strain to suspended membranes [1] can make Germanium a direct band-gap semiconductor, which is most promising way to low-threshold lasing [2]. The current key to reach the targeted high tensile strain is the quality of the Germanium. Epitaxied Germanium (Ge) on Silicon (Si) suffers from dislocations at its interface due to the lattice mismatch between Si and Ge (Figure 1 a). Higher crystalline quality can be obtained by fabricating Germanium on Insulator (GeOI) substrates by Smart Cut<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TM</sup> technology [3]. However, the processing has to be adapted to obtain specific “optical” GeOI substrates [4], much thicker than standard microelectronics GeOI.

articleTitle: Silicon IQ modulator based 80×337.9-Gb/s (42.24 Gbaud) Nyquist-WDM PDM-16QAM transmission over 960 km SSMF with EDFA link
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: Silicon IQ modulator based 80×337.9-Gb/s Nyquist-WDM transmission was experimentally investigated for 42.24 Gbaud PDM-16QAM. The single channel over 1600 km and Nil-channel transmissions over 960 km standard single-mode fiber (SSMF) with EDFA-only were successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Carrier-depletion Mach-Zehnder silicon optical modulator for high-speed and multi-level applications
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We demonstrate a 64-Gbps carrier-depletion modulator which also can be used to generate the PAM-4 optical signal. This proves that the silicon optical modulator is suitable for different kinds of applications.

articleTitle: Arbitrary self-configuring optics with silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: New mesh architectures of Mach-Zehnder interferometers with integrated detectors and simple feedback loops allow complex adaptive optical circuits for applications including mode conversion, arbitrary I incur processors, and quantum circuits - all self-designed and stabilized by training.

articleTitle: GeSn Fabry-Perot waveguide lasers for monolithic integration on Si
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present the fabrication and characterization of under-etched, optically pumped GeSn Fabry-Perot cavities. The influence of the waveguide geometry an the laser performance, e.g. lasing threshold, will be presented.

articleTitle: Bending and splitting of self-collimated waves on metallic square lattice
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: In metallic rod array, we demonstrate the bending and splitting of self-collimated spoof surface plasmon obtained from measured equi-frequency contour. The splitting ratio of self-collimated waves can be designed systematically by varying the height of rods.

articleTitle: Wavelength division demultiplexer and integrated III-V semiconductor lasers on a silicon photonics platform with microbubble manipulation
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We present details of a 1×4 angled multimode interferometer (de)multiplexer, integrated with a microdisk laser as a demonstration of the way in which the compound semiconductor lasers can be coupled to silicon devices for a multitude of applications.

articleTitle: Advances toward temperature-independent and fabrication-insensitive (de)multiplexer in the O-band
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: We describe the simulation, fabrication, and characterization of fabrication-insensitive multiplexers (MUX) based on echelle grating and temperature-independent cascaded Mach-Zehnder MUXs. The results show a clear improvement for both robustness axes.

articleTitle: Design of an ultra-compact hybrid VO2/silicon switch
publicationTitle: 2015 IEEE 12th International Conference on Group IV Photonics (GFP)
abstract: The design of a 2×2 optical switch bused on an add-drop ring resonator wilh u hybrid VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/silicon waveguide is proposed. The switch is characterized by low insertion losses and a footprint below 50 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.
